gameData.backstory: Once a bright-eyed optimist churning out motivational quips for corporate drones, 'Grim' Gutless saw his entire flock dissolve when the DRIP dried up in Sector 7. Now, fueled by rancid synth-chow and spite, he roams Subchain City, bringing his own brand of 'vigilante justice' to anyone hoarding resources.
gameData.name: 'Grim' Gutless
gameData.personality: Cynical and brooding, Grim masks his deep-seated trauma with sarcasm and a healthy dose of violence. He still occasionally spouts motivational phrases, but now they're laced with venom and usually precede a beatdown. Beneath the hardened exterior lies a flicker of the do-gooder he once aspired to be, but DRIP, or rather the lack of it, has a funny way of changing a duck.

specialAbility.description: Grim can channel his survivor's guilt into a burst of adrenaline-fueled action. For 3 turns, he gains +25% to agility and strength, ignoring the first instance of damage he receives in each of those turns. However, after the effect ends, he suffers a 15% penalty to intelligence as the emotional toll exacts a heavy price.
specialAbility.name: Guilt Trip
